findings.title: Email regex with nested quantifiers is vulnerable to ReDoS
findings.description: `([a-zA-Z0-9]+[._-]?)+` nests a quantifier inside a quantified group; a non-matching input like 40 'a' characters causes catastrophic backtracking and blocks the event loop on user-supplied signup data. Use a linear pattern (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+@...`), cap the input length, or use a validator library.
findings.suggestion: Replace with a non-nested pattern such as /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/ and cap length at 254.
